roles.functionStatement: Bring contaminated sites to protective, documented end states through characterization, remedy selection and oversight.

majorDuties.duty: Select remedies for contaminated sites and oversee cleanup through long-term stewardship

tasks.statement: Oversee a remediation contractor's field work against the approved design and health and safety plan, documenting deviations and corrective actions
Decide from performance monitoring data whether to optimize, continue or transition an operating remedy, recording the evidence for the decision
Conduct a periodic review of a closed site's remedy and institutional controls, recording whether the remedy remains protective

majorDuties.duty: Conduct environmental site assessment and site characterization

tasks.statement: Log soil cores and choose sample intervals in the field from lithology, staining, odor and field-screening readings
Oversee monitoring well installation and development, verifying screen placement against field lithology before the well is completed
Update the conceptual site model with new data, identifying the data gaps that still prevent a remedy decision

majorDuties.duty: Assess human health risks from environmental exposures

tasks.statement: Conduct an exposure assessment for an environmental contaminant, identifying pathways, receptors and exposure concentrations with documented assumptions.
Calculate health risks from environmental exposures with the methods the applicable requirements specify, stating the uncertainty of each estimate.
Communicate health risk findings to affected communities and decision-makers, explaining what the estimates mean for exposure and action.

majorDuties.duty: Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality

tasks.statement: Prepare progress reports for leadership from the project's tracking records, stating schedule and budget variance.
Break a large project into phased work packages with deliverables, dependencies and decision points
Maintain the project schedule baseline and record actual progress against it at each reporting period

majorDuties.duty: Manage field sample custody and field quality control

tasks.statement: Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them

majorDuties.duty: Direct and evaluate applicant- or contractor-prepared environmental documents

tasks.statement: Document the agency's independent evaluation of a sponsor-prepared document before adoption, recording what was verified and what was changed
Issue scope and content standards to a sponsor's contractor preparing an environmental document, specifying data, methods and the agency's review checkpoints

majorDuties.duty: Determine hazardous waste status and manage generator compliance

tasks.statement: Determine whether a waste stream is hazardous from process knowledge and laboratory data, documenting the listing and characteristic evaluation
Inspect satellite and central accumulation areas for container condition, labelling, dating and segregation, correcting deficiencies before shipment

majorDuties.duty: Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases

tasks.statement: Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response
Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it

majorDuties.duty: Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty

tasks.statement: Answer public questions about an uncertain environmental risk at a meeting or by phone using the current message map
Draft a public advisory that states the hazard, the people affected, the uncertainty and the protective action in plain language

majorDuties.duty: Investigate and manage emerging contaminants across media

tasks.statement: Interpret emerging-contaminant results against current and proposed criteria, stating how the conclusions change if the criteria change.

roles.functionStatement: Bring and keep air quality within standards through monitoring, planning, permitting and inspection.

instruments.label: Clean Air Act Title V operating permit programme
Clean Air Act new source review and PSD preconstruction permitting

majorDuties.duty: Build emissions inventories and air quality models for attainment planning

tasks.statement: Compile a point, area, mobile and natural source emissions inventory for a planning year with documented methods and activity data
Run a photochemical model for an attainment demonstration under an approved modelling protocol, documenting model performance against monitored data
Review a permit applicant's dispersion modelling analysis against the agreed protocol and guidance before accepting its conclusions
Check emissions estimates generated automatically from activity or sensor data against source tests and inventory methods before inclusion

majorDuties.duty: Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority

tasks.statement: Determine whether a proposed modification at a stationary source triggers major new source review from emissions increases and netting
Draft operating permit conditions for a major stationary air source with monitoring sufficient to show compliance with each applicable requirement
Review a control technology determination submitted with an air permit application against comparable sources and cost criteria
Check permit conditions drafted from a template or AI tool against the source's applicable requirements before public notice

majorDuties.duty: Operate ambient air monitoring networks to regulatory quality-assurance criteria

tasks.statement: Audit a regulatory air monitor's flow and gas calibration against transfer standards following the quality assurance project plan
Validate a quarter's ambient monitoring data against quality-assurance criteria, flagging or invalidating values before data certification
Collocate low-cost sensors with a regulatory monitor to derive correction factors, documenting sensor performance before the data are published

majorDuties.duty: Conduct regulatory compliance inspections

tasks.statement: Inspect a permitted facility or site against its permit conditions and applicable rules, recording observations, measurements and samples as evidence
Read visible emissions from a stationary source following the certified opacity-observation method, recording each reading and observation condition
Collect samples and photographs during an inspection under chain-of-custody procedures, so that the evidence is admissible in an enforcement proceeding

majorDuties.duty: Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty

tasks.statement: Answer public questions about an uncertain environmental risk at a meeting or by phone using the current message map
Draft a public advisory that states the hazard, the people affected, the uncertainty and the protective action in plain language
Prepare a shared message map with partner agencies for an emerging environmental or health incident

majorDuties.duty: Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs

tasks.statement: Respond to an overseeing agency's objection to a permit issued under delegated authority, revising the permit or defending it with a written record
Assess whether a proposed change to program rules keeps them at least as stringent as the delegated authority requires, documenting each provision compared

majorDuties.duty: Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases

tasks.statement: Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response
Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it

majorDuties.duty: Build organizational and jurisdictional greenhouse gas inventories for disclosure and reporting

tasks.statement: Compile a greenhouse gas inventory for an organization or jurisdiction, documenting boundaries, activity data, emission factors and methods for each source.
Maintain the evidence trail and controls behind inventory figures so that an assurance provider can trace each figure to its source data.

majorDuties.duty: Analyze cumulative burdens and distributional effects of environmental decisions

tasks.statement: Screen a proposed project's area for existing environmental and health burdens using screening indicators, recording each indicator's source, date and known limitations
Estimate how a proposed permit or project changes cumulative burdens on affected communities, stating the uncertainty and assumptions behind each estimate

majorDuties.duty: Build, run and validate environmental forecast and scenario systems

tasks.statement: Build an operational forecast or scenario system for an ecosystem or infrastructure asset that assimilates real-time sensor observations.
Simulate alternative management actions in a forecast or scenario system, reporting the spread of outcomes and the system's validated range.

majorDuties.duty: Plan smoke management for prescribed and managed fire within air quality requirements

tasks.statement: Prepare the smoke management section of a burn plan, identifying sensitive receptors, dispersion limits and contingency actions
